d: A snake in an unexpected hiding place, a raccoon causing trouble or a turtle that refuses to be caught. The wild has a way of creating some rather unusual problems! Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, and Neal James find themselves dealing with an assortment of creatures that need catching, rescuing or safely removing. From slippery snakes and stubborn turtles to quick-moving raccoons and elusive mink, these missions take them into some truly unexpected situations.
